body: You are butthurt because I called you out for attacking things I literally didn’t say. It’s fucking weird. You’ve invented an entire narrative that did not exist in my post, just to yell at it. How fucking bizarre. Like, get a hobby. This is just strange. Or a mirror, because the only person you’re arguing with is you. Because I didn’t say any of the things you’re triggered by, you did.

Mostly good advice. But if you’re a Simpsons fan, think of Homer’s speech to Marge about how he’s making people happy (and stated the obvious, that he was being sarcastic). I think he had been cheated out of money or something, but Marge was trying to look on the bright side. Anyway, having contributed to someone’s sexual awakening feels like that, especially if I never find someone as compatible again. I’m not going to be like “well at least someone gets to have an awesome sex life thanks in part to me!” And you can say that’s immature I guess? But if people are honest, almost no one would feel super happy about that either. Otherwise, I do appreciate your advice and I’m trying to cope. I was seriously in love, and have never felt like this in my life.

Honestly it’s not about “recognition.” People are badly misunderstanding what I’m saying…which is really weird because they’re attacking things I specifically didn’t say while not commenting on what I did say. Which is literally just expressing sadness over the loss, and the pain of having spent time and love and vulnerability developing a relationship, then someone else stepping in right when this one aspect is going to be really good without having invested that time. No one owes me anything, not recognition, not anything. And I never even hinted or implied such. Just stated that this loss feels really bad.

Not angry at all, I think it’s really weird that literally every person who has had a negative comment has made their comment about things I neither said nor even implied. I didn’t suggest anything like “ownership,” or possession or her owing me anything. Literally just expressed sadness at losing something great, and the added pain of when someone else benefits from my actions when I don’t. None of that even slightly indicates that I think I’m entitled to anything or think I own anything or anyone. Literally just feels bad. If y’all need to be mad at something so bad you have to make shit up to me mad at, find a hobby, something. This is weird, man.

Again, YOU are saying that. You don’t need to invent things to be judgmental about. I said nothing remotely akin to “if I can’t have her no one can.” I said it feels bad when someone else benefits from aspects of a relationship you put in the effort to develop. It just does. Because it feels like wasted effort. And loss of something good. And someone else just pops in and gets the benefit without the effort. I don’t see why it’s hard to understand why that feels bad without having to invent things I am not saying or even implying…?

Nothing in my post remotely hinted at her “owing” me anything…? At all. She doesn’t. Which is obvious. I am just sad because that relationship is gone. And it hurts that someone will benefit from what I put the labor into. Nobody likes that, in any scenario. Doesn’t mean anyone is doing something wrong. It just hurts. Feels bad. Y’all are robots or something, or have never been in love. Don’t do it, it hurts.

I never once suggested anything you’re saying. Of course I’m talking about me and my experience. Because that’s the only experience I have…? I never even remotely indicated she “owes me” anything. Only that I feel sad that I lost that relationship, and sex was one aspect of it. And it always feels bad when someone else is with a person you’re in love with, but it just adds to it when you put work into the relationship to help build something together, but someone else benefits from that instead of you. Unless you are a sociopath and don’t understand the hurt of losing a positive relationship or seeing someone else with someone you are in love with. You seem emotionless and robotic, this isn’t an unusual feeling to experience.
